# InvigoMedia

> > InvigoMedia is a comprehensive healthcare marketing agency specializing in HIPAA-compliant digital solutions for medical practices and wellness businesses.

InvigoMedia provides end-to-end medical marketing services including AI-powered CRM software (EverGenius), SEO, paid advertising, website design, and dedicated account management. The company serves healthcare providers across multiple specialties with a focus on patient acquisition, engagement, and practice growth.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA-compliant marketing
- Patient acquisition
- Medical practice growth
- EverGenius CRM
- Healthcare SEO
- Marketing automation
- AI-powered solutions
- PPC advertising
- Patient engagement
- Email marketing
- SMS marketing
- Medical website design
- Lead generation
- Google Ads
- Local SEO

- [Services For Medical Practice Growth by InvigoMedia](https://invigomedia.com/services): InvigoMedia's full suite of healthcare marketing services with dedicated managers
